coverage.method: Read every unique source-target pair; context-checked potentially ambiguous UI labels and reference-image slots. Text-only semantic review; no fresh asset inspection, no native-speaker claim.

findings.reason: These are required reference-image slots for a person, pet or product. Subject means depicted subject, but 주제 means theme/topic. Adjacent Korean upload instructions already use 대상. Do not apply this change to the taxonomy field-group or ink-wash template subject field, where 주제 is appropriate.

notes: All UI ICU branches and placeholders were compared in source-target pairs; formal parser validation is delegated to parent strict checks.
Two fixed language particles occur only with the current page nativeName 한국어, so no present runtime grammar error was identified.
a_269 alt source/target difference is an explicitly documented image-inspection correction.

resolution.method: Exact pending candidates separately compared with their sources by AI Codex root, then applied with locale:import and locale:promote dry-run/apply. Baseline hashes in this audit describe the pre-correction text.
